claim: Hashes every selected APK byte on this device
sandbox: Select a deterministic APK-shaped fixture and assert its complete known SHA-256 in the evidence dialog

claim: Reads one unverified embedded certificate fingerprint from v2/v3 signing blocks
where: Landing workflow, record card, evidence dialog, README
sandbox: Select a deterministic v2/v3-block fixture; assert both scheme labels, the certificate-byte digest, and the unverified warning

claim: Requires an APK-shaped ZIP directory containing AndroidManifest.xml
where: Landing workflow, record dialog, Terms, README
sandbox: Select non-ZIP bytes and an inconsistent local/central ZIP entry; assert both are rejected

claim: Exports password-encrypted records and optional saved APK copies
where: Landing facts and workflow, export dialog, README
sandbox: Export a saved 12 MiB fixture; assert plaintext names are absent and the supplied password opens it with a matching hash

claim: The restore-kit password is never stored
sandbox: Export with a unique password and search localStorage, sessionStorage, and Cache Storage for it

claim: Records and optional APK copies are stored on this device
sandbox: Record a real fixture, reload, and assert it persists only in the real local namespace

claim: Remove erases a record and its saved APK copy
sandbox: Save a fixture, prove metadata and bytes exist, remove it, then assert the real record list and IndexedDB store are empty

claim: Demo data is separate and erased when leaving demo mode
sandbox: Add demo metadata and bytes, choose Start for real, then assert the demo localStorage key and IndexedDB database are absent

claim: The demo needs no account and makes no automatic third-party requests
sandbox: Run and reset demo while recording requests; assert no account input and only the product origin

claim: Demo reloads offline after the first visit
sandbox: Load /demo, disable the browser HTTP cache, go offline, reload, and assert the shell and sample records render

claim: The landing page links directly to the v0.2.0 APK, AAB, and SHA256SUMS assets
sandbox: Assert deterministic GitHub release-asset URLs and that page load makes no GitHub API request
